Name: FishingLab v1
Author: BigDipper00111
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
FishingLab is an experimental fishing framework for Stardew Valley that focuses on automating and studying the game's fishing mechanics. The project provides a platform for testing different fishing strategies, real-time minigame control, and future fishing-related quality-of-life features.
The current release introduces the first stage of the FishingLab project: automated fishing minigame assistance with intelligent fish tracking and treasure prioritization.

[b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download FishingLab.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]FishingLab[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Load a save file.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F8[/b] to toggle FishingLab automation on or off.[/*]
[/list]Example directory:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── FishingLab/
        ├── FishingLab.dll
        ├── manifest.json
        └── ...[/code][line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
Fishing Minigame Automation
[list]
[*]Toggle automation at any time using a hotkey (F8)[/*]
[*]Automatically tracks fish movement in real time.[/*]
[*]Maintains the fishing bar on the target fish.[/*]
[*]Prioritizes treasure chests when they appear.[/*]
[*]Returns to fish tracking once treasure is secured.[/*]
[/list]Session Safety
[list]
[*]Monitors in-game time.[/*]
[*]Automatically terminates fishing activity before late-night collapse conditions.[/*]
[/list]Experimental Fishing Framework
[list]
[*]Built as a foundation for future fishing research and automation systems.[/*]
[*]Designed to support multiple fishing strategies and behaviors.[/*]
[*]Serves as a testing platform for advanced fishing mechanics.[/*]
[/list]Developer-Oriented Architecture
[list]
[*]Clean SMAPI-based implementation.[/*]
[*]Extensible codebase for future experimentation.[/*]
[*]Intended to grow into a complete fishing toolkit rather than a single-purpose mod.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
Required
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[/list]Recommended
[list]
[*]Latest SMAPI release for maximum compatibility.[/*]
[*]A backup save file when testing experimental features.[/*]
[/list]Compatibility
FishingLab currently focuses exclusively on the vanilla fishing minigame. Compatibility with mods that heavily modify fishing behavior may vary.
[line]
[heading]Shout Outs[/heading]

[/list]And finally, thanks to everyone willing to experiment with FishingLab while it evolves into a larger fishing automation and analysis framework. 🎣
